newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close lower on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close lower on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed lower on Monday's settlement day on position-squaring in a depressed market, traders said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index closed 23.79 points, or 1.60 percent, lower at 1,462.54 amid 170 losers and 72 gainers. Volume fell to 42 million shares from Sunday's 47 million.

Selling by local institutions triggered a bearish spell throughout the trading session, and prompted position-squaring by small investors, trader Faisal Abbas said. Another factor was an unchanged high carryover transaction rate called "badla".
"The index's sharp slide shows that most holdings were made by small players, who are unable to hold their positions," dealer Sajjad Mankani said.
Fauji Fertilizer dived 4.00 rupees to 69, PSO 3.00 to 386, PTCL 0.65 to 27.50, HUBCO 0.60 to 34.45, ICI Pakistan 0.50 to 20.50 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.50 to 34.50.
